goal: Complete the presentation for the existing skill-card gacha so drawing cards is satisfying, readable, repeatable, and connected to skill editing.
acceptance_criteria: The existing monster and character skill pools, COST rarity weights, 100/900 coin prices, and COST 2+ ten-draw guarantee remain unchanged.
A staged full-screen summon presents exact highest-COST anticipation followed by individual card reveals and stronger high-COST treatment.
Results identify first acquisitions and sequential owned counts without adding save fields or changing inventory semantics.
Players can skip, use a quick presentation, repeat the same draw when affordable, close the result, or continue to party skill editing.
Reduced-motion preference bypasses prolonged motion and the draw is saved before presentation so interruption cannot lose rewards.
The presentation remains usable on narrow mobile screens and a player-facing notice describes the completed change.

phases.name: goal_and_boundary
phases.deliverable: Fixed the existing-skill-gacha-only scope, compatibility boundary, acceptance criteria, checks, publication verification, and stop condition.

phases.name: presentation_implementation
phases.deliverable: Implemented the Skill Sigil summon, exact rarity anticipation, staged card reveal, acquisition labels, speed controls, haptics, and result actions.

phases.name: integration_qa_and_safe_merge
phases.deliverable: Dedicated and full checks passed; PR #140 CI succeeded from current main without conflict and was squash-merged.

phases.name: pages_and_published_verification
phases.deliverable: Main CI and Pages succeeded; published HTML, JavaScript, CSS, notice, and interaction contracts were verified.

phases.name: completion_and_stop
phases.deliverable: Final evidence is recorded, the v1 waiting state is restored, and no further backlog item is selected.

published_verification: The published HTML references the skill-gacha presentation cache keys and includes the summon dialog plus standard/quick controls.
The published JavaScript includes exact highest-COST anticipation, sequential reveal, NEW and owned tracking, skip, repeat draw, skill-change routing, haptics, and reduced-motion handling.
The published CSS includes the full-screen summon, COST-tier treatment, card flips, and a narrow-screen two-row layout for ten cards.
The published notice announces the Skill Sigil presentation and its player-facing controls.
Dedicated and full automated checks preserve the existing pools, rates, prices, guarantee, inventory behavior, and save compatibility.
stop_condition: After Phase 58 is recorded and published, do not select or start another backlog item.
